message: Last week, we had a surprise power outage that left the whole neighborhood in darkness. I had just finished telling my husband that we should really have a backup plan for these situations, and wouldn’t you know it, I felt a bit smug when I pulled out our trusty flashlights and power banks while everyone else was scrambling. It’s amazing how a little preparation can turn a frustrating moment into a cozy evening with games and snacks. Have you ever had a ‘I told you so’ moment during a blackout?
